You will operate and evolve networking infrastructure across multiple cloud and hosting providers, alongside an AWS-based control plane and supporting backend services. The role combines hands-on network engineering, DevOps, infrastructure automation, security, observability, and production operations. You will inherit a live environment, understand its architecture and risks, and progressively make it more reliable, automated, secure, and cost-efficient. Agentic AI tools are an important part of the engineering workflow, helping accelerate development, investigation, documentation, and operational automation. Working within a small, highly collaborative engineering team, you will have substantial ownership over infrastructure that directly impacts users around the world. Operate, stabilize, and continuously improve VPN infrastructure, AWS-based control plane services, backend systems, and supporting operational tooling. Analyze the existing production environment, document its architecture and dependencies, and identify the most significant reliability, security, scalability, and cost risks. Replace manual operational procedures and runbooks with infrastructure-as-code, automation, repeatable deployments, and self-service workflows. Build and strengthen CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, deployment safeguards, observability, and reliable rollback mechanisms. Manage VPN networking technologies and infrastructure, including server provisioning, configuration, routing, NAT, DNS, TLS, traffic shaping, health monitoring, failover, and key management. Develop monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident-response capabilities to improve availability and operational resilience. Troubleshoot production incidents, participate in 24/7 on-call operations, perform root-cause analysis, and ensure recurring issues are addressed through automation and system improvements. Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to balance uptime, latency, connection success rates, capacity, infrastructure costs, and overall user experience. Contribute to iterative two-week development cycles by testing hypotheses, validating feasibility, and delivering well-tested, version-controlled infrastructure changes. Strengthen security practices covering secrets management, encryption, least-privilege access, vulnerability management, server hardening, and relevant privacy and compliance requirements. Strong networking knowledge covering iptables/nftables, WireGuard, routing, NAT, DNS, TLS/certificates, and traffic shaping. Experience with WireGuard, Shadowsocks, OpenVPN, or IKEv2/IPsec at scale is highly desirable. Experience with observability and alerting tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Cloudflare, and centralized logging, alongside production incident response. Strong CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions or similar platforms, including automated testing, safe deployment practices, and rollback strategies. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Go, Bash, or comparable languages. Strong understanding of security fundamentals, including Vault, AWS Secrets Manager or SSM, encryption in transit and at rest, least-privilege IAM, vulnerability scanning, and hardening of public-facing infrastructure. Demonstrated day-to-day proficiency with agentic AI tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot agents, combined with sound judgment and rigorous verification of AI-generated infrastructure code. Proven experience owning production operations, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and improving systems to reduce recurring manual work. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with the independence to deliver confidently while recognizing when collaboration or escalation is required. Strong communication skills, empathy, accountability, curiosity, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to improving systems and processes. Passion for technology and a willingness to continuously learn and adopt new engineering practices and tools. Open PTO, company holidays, and wellness days for eligible full-time employees. Opportunity to take significant ownership of a live, globally distributed VPN infrastructure. Work with modern cloud, networking, infrastructure-as-code, observability, security, automation, and agentic AI technologies. Close collaboration with experienced engineering and product professionals in a small, agile environment. Review vendor security advisories, software recommendations, defects, and EOS/EOL notices, and translate applicable findings into remediation and lifecycle activities. Serve as the technical lead for incidents affecting WAN infrastructure, routing platforms, SD-WAN services, and production upgrade activities. Participate in outage calls, major incident bridges, and technical recovery activities; perform root cause analysis and define corrective and preventive actions. Support Problem Management by analyzing recurring issues, identifying trends, and driving permanent technical resolutions. Lead assigned remediation waves, upgrade deployments, infrastructure refreshes, and network improvement initiatives. Coordinate testing, validation, implementation, and stabilization activities, and track technical risks, dependencies, actions, and delivery progress. Provide operational feedback, implementation considerations, and technical recommendations for proposed network design changes when requested. Maintain implementation procedures, operational runbooks, remediation documentation, software compliance records, upgrade history, and deployment outcomes. Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, monitoring, analytics, and operational efficiency. Provide technical guidance to Associate and Senior Associate engineers and support consistent execution of WAN remediation and lifecycle activities. Advanced understanding of BGP, OSPF, routing policies, route selection, redundancy, VPN services, QoS, and WAN failover. review_candidates.description: Ready to take your career global? Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Senior Firewall Engineer (Level 3) to join our Global Network Security team and help secure our mission-critical infrastructure. You’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise firewall solutions while driving security improvements across our global environment. What You’ll Own Provide Level 3 technical support for enterprise firewall environments, acting as the highest escalation point for complex incidents and critical outages. Design, implement, maintain, and optimize Check Point Firewall environments, including Security Gateways, Management Servers, VSX, ClusterXL, VPNs, NAT, IPS, Identity Awareness, Application Control, URL Filtering, and Threat Prevention. Perform advanced troubleshooting of network security issues involving routing, switching, firewall policies, VPN connectivity, SSL inspection, and application traffic. Lead firewall policy reviews, rule optimization, cleanup activities, and compliance initiatives while ensuring adherence to security standards. Collaborate with Network, Cloud, Infrastructure, Security Operations, and Application teams to deliver secure solutions for new business initiatives. Plan and execute firewall upgrades, migrations, operating system updates, and hardware refresh activities with minimal business impact. Participate in security architecture reviews and recommend improvements based on industry best practices. Investigate security incidents and provide root cause analysis along with preventive recommendations. Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, implementation guides, and knowledge articles. Participate in an on-call rotation and provide support during planned maintenance and critical production incidents. What You’ll Bring Strong experience administering Check Point Firewall platforms in large enterprise environments. Deep understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols, NAT, VPN technologies, SSL/TLS, DNS, and enterprise networking concepts. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex firewall and network security issues across distributed global environments. Strong knowledge of firewall policy management, threat prevention technologies, and security best practices. Experience working with high-availability firewall clusters and disaster recovery environments. Ability to analyze logs using SmartConsole, SmartView, SmartEvent, Log Exporter, and related monitoring tools. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to lead technical discussions and mentor junior engineers. Strong documentation skills and commitment to operational excellence. A proactive mindset with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, and delivering secure, reliable services. It’s a bonus if you have Experience with Check Point Maestro, VSX, Multi-Domain Management (MDM), or CloudGuard. Experience with additional firewall technologies such as Palo Alto, Cisco Firepower. Knowledge of cloud networking and security (Google Cloud). Experience with automation using Python, Ansible, Terraform, or REST APIs. Experience with change management processes and ITIL best practices. Relevant certifications such as Check Point CCSA, CCSE, CCSM, CISSP, or equivalent. About The Team Our Global Network Security team protects critical payment infrastructure across multiple regions, ensuring secure, highly available, and compliant network services. We work closely with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Security Operations, and Application teams to safeguard business operations while enabling innovation and growth. They are passionate about solving complex technical challenges, continuously improving our security posture, and delivering resilient solutions that protect our customers and our business. We’re looking for professionals who are curious, accountable, customer-focused, and committed to operational excellence.
